name: com.maraudical.statuseffectsframework
description: A framework for implementing custom status effects.

samples.description: If you aren't using the Entities package you should download this sample.
If you are using the Netcode for GameObjects package you should download this sample. It includes everything from the Default sample.
If you are using the UniTask package you should download this sample instead of the Default sample.
If you are using the Entities package you should download this sample.
If you are using the Netcode for Entities package you should download this sample. It includes everything from the Entities sample.
